title: Volleyball
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Practise with a light ball over a low net; questions ask for body position and contact point.

skills.key_step: The child describes the under-arm serve (hit from below the waist with the heel of the hand) and the dig (straight joined forearms, knees bent).

floor.prerequisite: Catches and passes with two hands (Grade 4).
floor.question: In netball, where do you look when catching?

steps: Serve: hold the ball low, swing the hand from below.
Bend the knees and push up.

board.do: Join the hands with straight arms.

misconceptions.ask: In volleyball, what must a player not do with the ball?
misconceptions.repair: Play a short game where catching the ball loses the point.

misconceptions.ask: Which part of the body is used for a dig pass?
misconceptions.repair: Practise with a soft ball: hold the forearms together and lift a low ball.

misconceptions.ask: Where is the ball when it is struck in an under-arm serve?
misconceptions.repair: Compare the two serves with a soft ball.

misconceptions.ask: In a dig pass, should you swing your arms up high?
misconceptions.repair: Dig with straight arms and a small leg push.

checks.question: Which part of the body hits the ball in a dig?
In an under-arm serve, where is the ball hit from?
